from collections import Counter
def complete_dashed(grid, new=2, thresh=4):
    """Fill background cells lying on a dashed line (row/col with >= thresh shape cells) inside the shape's bounding box."""
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]!=bg and grid[i][j]!=new]
    if not cells: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if sum(1 for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]!=bg and grid[i][j]!=new)>=thresh]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if sum(1 for i in range(h) if grid[i][j]!=bg and grid[i][j]!=new)>=thresh]
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if g[i][j]==bg and (i in rows or j in cols): g[i][j]=new
    return g
